paragraphs.source_en: On the fourteenth day of the seventh month in the fifth year of Keichō, Mōri Terumoto received a letter of invitation in Hiroshima. Secretly drafted after consultations among Ishida Mitsunari, Ōtani Yoshitsugu, Ankokuji Ekei, and others, it bore the joint signatures of three commissioners.

units.source_en: On the fourteenth day of the seventh month in the fifth year of Keichō, Mōri Terumoto received a letter of invitation in Hiroshima. Secretly drafted after consultations among Ishida Mitsunari, Ōtani Yoshitsugu, Ankokuji Ekei, and others, it bore the joint signatures of three commissioners.
units.source_zh: 庆长五年七月十四，毛利辉元在广岛收到一封邀请书函，信函由石田三成、大谷吉继、安国寺惠琼等人秘密商议后书写，有三位奉行的联合署名。

paragraphs.source_zh: 庆长五年七月十四，毛利辉元在广岛收到一封邀请书函，信函由石田三成、大谷吉继、安国寺惠琼等人秘密商议后书写，有三位奉行的联合署名。

paragraphs.source_en: “Regarding the situation in Osaka, we have now obtained His Lordship’s sanction. Please enter the castle without delay. We had intended to send Master Ekei to receive you and explain the circumstances in detail, but events arose so suddenly that he was ultimately unable to depart. We therefore ask that you set out with all possible speed…”

units.source_en: “Regarding the situation in Osaka, we have now obtained His Lordship’s sanction. Please enter the castle without delay.

ja.t: につきましては、すでに

units.source_zh: “大坂一事，现已得到上意，请及早进城。

units.source_en: We had intended to send Master Ekei to receive you and explain the circumstances in detail, but events arose so suddenly that he was ultimately unable to depart.
units.source_zh: 本想派惠琼大师前去迎接并细说原委，但事出突然，终未成行。

units.source_en: We therefore ask that you set out with all possible speed…”
units.source_zh: 还请火速起程……”

paragraphs.source_zh: “大坂一事，现已得到上意，请及早进城。本想派惠琼大师前去迎接并细说原委，但事出突然，终未成行。还请火速起程……”

paragraphs.source_en: The senders were the three commissioners Nagatsuka Masaie, Mashita Nagamori, and Maeda Gen’i. Judging from its contents alone, some matter of the utmost urgency appeared to have arisen. Mitsunari and Yoshitsugu had, of course, been deliberately omitted from the letter; but Ekei had already sent Terumoto a separate message, so he understood its meaning at once.

units.source_en: The senders were the three commissioners Nagatsuka Masaie, Mashita Nagamori, and Maeda Gen’i.
units.source_zh: 发信人是长束正家、增田长盛、前田玄以三奉行。

units.source_en: Judging from its contents alone, some matter of the utmost urgency appeared to have arisen.
units.source_zh: 单看内容，仿佛是发生了十万火急之事。

units.source_en: Mitsunari and Yoshitsugu had, of course, been deliberately omitted from the letter; but Ekei had already sent Terumoto a separate message, so he understood its meaning at once.
units.source_zh: 当然，书中刻意略去了三成和吉继，但由于惠琼早就另外修书给毛利辉元，他一看便知其意。

paragraphs.source_zh: 发信人是长束正家、增田长盛、前田玄以三奉行。单看内容，仿佛是发生了十万火急之事。当然，书中刻意略去了三成和吉继，但由于惠琼早就另外修书给毛利辉元，他一看便知其意。

paragraphs.source_en: Early on the fifteenth, Terumoto left Hiroshima with his six-year-old son Hidenari and reached Osaka on the evening of the sixteenth.

units.source_en: Early on the fifteenth, Terumoto left Hiroshima with his six-year-old son Hidenari and reached Osaka on the evening of the sixteenth.
units.source_zh: 十五日一早，辉元带着年仅六岁的儿子秀就从广岛出发，十六日晚抵达大坂。

paragraphs.source_zh: 十五日一早，辉元带着年仅六岁的儿子秀就从广岛出发，十六日晚抵达大坂。

paragraphs.source_en: Taking Ieyasu’s place in the Western Bailey, Mōri Terumoto sent his son Hidenari to attend Hideyori. On the seventeenth he convened a council, at which it was decided to issue a manifesto calling for the punishment of Tokugawa Ieyasu. Mitsunari and the others had prepared everything long beforehand; the so-called council was merely a formality.

units.source_en: Taking Ieyasu’s place in the Western Bailey, Mōri Terumoto sent his son Hidenari to attend Hideyori. On the seventeenth he convened a council, at which it was decided to issue a manifesto calling for the punishment of Tokugawa Ieyasu.
units.source_zh: 毛利辉元取代家康驻入西苑，令儿子秀就去秀赖身边侍奉，并于十七日召众议事，决定发表讨伐德川家康的檄文。

units.source_en: Mitsunari and the others had prepared everything long beforehand; the so-called council was merely a formality.
units.source_zh: 三成等人早就准备好，所谓商议只是走走过场。

paragraphs.source_zh: 毛利辉元取代家康驻入西苑，令儿子秀就去秀赖身边侍奉，并于十七日召众议事，决定发表讨伐德川家康的檄文。三成等人早就准备好，所谓商议只是走走过场。

paragraphs.source_en: The manifesto listed thirteen charges against Tokugawa Ieyasu.

units.source_en: The manifesto listed thirteen charges against Tokugawa Ieyasu.
units.source_zh: 檄文共列举德川家康罪状十三条。

paragraphs.source_zh: 檄文共列举德川家康罪状十三条。

paragraphs.source_en: First: he acted arbitrarily and forced two commissioners into retirement.

units.source_en: First: he acted arbitrarily and forced two commissioners into retirement.
units.source_zh: 一、独断专行，逼迫二奉行隐退。

paragraphs.source_zh: 一、独断专行，逼迫二奉行隐退。

paragraphs.source_en: Second: in order to attack Uesugi Kagekatsu, one of the Five Elders, he forced Maeda Toshinaga to submit a written oath and demanded hostages.

units.source_en: Second: in order to attack Uesugi Kagekatsu, one of the Five Elders, he forced Maeda Toshinaga to submit a written oath and demanded hostages.
units.source_zh: 二、为攻打五大老之一上杉景胜，逼迫前田利长写下誓书，索取人质。

paragraphs.source_zh: 二、为攻打五大老之一上杉景胜，逼迫前田利长写下誓书，索取人质。

paragraphs.source_en: Third: Kagekatsu had violated none of the Taikō’s laws. Yet Ieyasu ignored the remonstrations of the commissioners and forcibly dispatched an army against him.

units.source_en: Third: Kagekatsu had violated none of the Taikō’s laws.
units.source_zh: 三、景胜并未触犯太阁法令。

units.source_en: Yet Ieyasu ignored the remonstrations of the commissioners and forcibly dispatched an army against him.
units.source_zh: 不听诸位奉行谏言，强行出兵征讨。

paragraphs.source_zh: 三、景胜并未触犯太阁法令。不听诸位奉行谏言，强行出兵征讨。

paragraphs.source_en: Fourth: relying on his power, he arbitrarily granted additional lands—the reference was to his bestowal upon Hosokawa Tadaoki of the sixty-thousand-koku fief of Kitsuki.

units.source_en: Fourth: relying on his power, he arbitrarily granted additional lands—the reference was to his bestowal upon Hosokawa Tadaoki of the sixty-thousand-koku fief of Kitsuki.
units.source_zh: 四、恃权任意加封土地（指赐细川忠兴杵筑之六万石领地一事）。

paragraphs.source_zh: 四、恃权任意加封土地（指赐细川忠兴杵筑之六万石领地一事）。

paragraphs.source_en: Fifth: he expelled the generals whom the Taikō had assigned to guard Fushimi Castle and stationed his own troops there without authorization.

units.source_en: Fifth: he expelled the generals whom the Taikō had assigned to guard Fushimi Castle and stationed his own troops there without authorization.
units.source_zh: 五、逐太阁伏见城留守诸将，私自驻兵。

paragraphs.source_zh: 五、逐太阁伏见城留守诸将，私自驻兵。

paragraphs.source_en: Sixth: he appropriated Kōdai-in’s Western Bailey as his residence.

units.source_en: Sixth: he appropriated Kōdai-in’s Western Bailey as his residence.
units.source_zh: 六、占高台院西苑为居所。

paragraphs.source_zh: 六、占高台院西苑为居所。

paragraphs.source_en: There were further accusations: that he had built a castle tower in the Western Bailey; freely allowed the wives and children of various lords to return to their domains; and, on Lady Okame’s account, arbitrarily granted lands in Yawata to the priests of Iwashimizu, among other things. The manifesto declared that all these acts constituted compelling evidence that Ieyasu intended to steal the realm from the Toyotomi clan.

units.source_en: There were further accusations: that he had built a castle tower in the Western Bailey; freely allowed the wives and children of various lords to return to their domains; and, on Lady Okame’s account, arbitrarily granted lands in Yawata to the priests of Iwashimizu, among other things.
units.source_zh: 此外，在西苑筑天守阁，随意让诸将妻小回归本领，由于阿龟夫人的缘故，擅自将八幡土地赏赐给石清水神官等。

units.source_en: The manifesto declared that all these acts constituted compelling evidence that Ieyasu intended to steal the realm from the Toyotomi clan.
units.source_zh: 檄文声称，这些都是家康企图盗取丰臣氏天下的有力证据。

paragraphs.source_zh: 此外，在西苑筑天守阁，随意让诸将妻小回归本领，由于阿龟夫人的缘故，擅自将八幡土地赏赐给石清水神官等。檄文声称，这些都是家康企图盗取丰臣氏天下的有力证据。

paragraphs.source_en: The claim that Ieyasu had abandoned Hideyori to march east against Uesugi Kagekatsu as part of a conspiracy to destroy, one by one, the lords deeply indebted to the Toyotomi was an excuse Mitsunari had labored to find—and a reason with which to persuade Mōri Terumoto to take up arms.

units.source_en: The claim that Ieyasu had abandoned Hideyori to march east against Uesugi Kagekatsu as part of a conspiracy to destroy, one by one, the lords deeply indebted to the Toyotomi was an excuse Mitsunari had labored to find—and a reason with which to persuade Mōri Terumoto to take up arms.
units.source_zh: 弃秀赖于不顾，东去讨伐上杉景胜，乃家康企图逐一消灭受丰臣重恩诸将的阴谋云云，是三成苦心寻找的借口，也是说服毛利辉元起兵的理由。

paragraphs.source_zh: 弃秀赖于不顾，东去讨伐上杉景胜，乃家康企图逐一消灭受丰臣重恩诸将的阴谋云云，是三成苦心寻找的借口，也是说服毛利辉元起兵的理由。

paragraphs.source_en: Better to strike first than sit waiting for death—so Ekei pressed Terumoto again and again, arguing that if Uesugi Kagekatsu resisted Ieyasu with all his strength, the coming war could only end in victory.

units.source_en: Better to strike first than sit waiting for death—so Ekei pressed Terumoto again and again, arguing that if Uesugi Kagekatsu resisted Ieyasu with all his strength, the coming war could only end in victory.
units.source_zh: 与其坐以待毙，不如先发制人——惠琼就这样不断游说辉元，若上杉景胜拼命抵挡家康，这场战事有胜无败。

paragraphs.source_zh: 与其坐以待毙，不如先发制人——惠琼就这样不断游说辉元，若上杉景胜拼命抵挡家康，这场战事有胜无败。

paragraphs.source_en: The manifesto was proclaimed throughout the realm on the fifteenth day of the seventh month in the fifth year of Keichō, and the western provinces went on a war footing.

units.source_en: The manifesto was proclaimed throughout the realm on the fifteenth day of the seventh month in the fifth year of Keichō, and the western provinces went on a war footing.
units.source_zh: 檄文于庆长五年七月十五公布天下，西边如临大敌。

paragraphs.source_zh: 檄文于庆长五年七月十五公布天下，西边如临大敌。

paragraphs.source_en: Nabeshima Katsushige, Wakisaka Yasumoto, Maeda Gen’i’s son Shigekatsu, and others had intended to serve under Ieyasu and had already advanced as far as the Echigawa area of Ōmi. Ishida Mitsunari’s son Shigemasa barred their way, however, and in the end they led their contingents back to Osaka.

units.source_en: Nabeshima Katsushige, Wakisaka Yasumoto, Maeda Gen’i’s son Shigekatsu, and others had intended to serve under Ieyasu and had already advanced as far as the Echigawa area of Ōmi. Ishida Mitsunari’s son Shigemasa barred their way, however, and in the end they led their contingents back to Osaka.
units.source_zh: 在石田三成之子正隆的阻拦下，本欲在家康手下效力的锅岛胜茂、胁坂安元、前田玄以之子茂胜等人，尽管已开赴近江爱知川一带，最终还是率领各部返回了大坂。

paragraphs.source_zh: 在石田三成之子正隆的阻拦下，本欲在家康手下效力的锅岛胜茂、胁坂安元、前田玄以之子茂胜等人，尽管已开赴近江爱知川一带，最终还是率领各部返回了大坂。

paragraphs.source_en: The families of the generals who had gone east with Ieyasu were naturally forbidden to return to their domains. On Mashita Nagamori’s orders, messengers galloped in every direction to demand hostages: to Kyōgoku Takatsugu at Ōtsu, Kutsuki Mototsuna in Kutsukidani, Tōdō Takatora, Date Masamune…

units.source_en: The families of the generals who had gone east with Ieyasu were naturally forbidden to return to their domains. On Mashita Nagamori’s orders, messengers galloped in every direction to demand hostages: to Kyōgoku Takatsugu at Ōtsu, Kutsuki Mototsuna in Kutsukidani, Tōdō Takatora, Date Masamune…
units.source_zh: 随家康东去的诸将家眷自然严禁归领，在增田长盛的命令下，使者为人质之事飞驰向四面八方：大津京极高次处、朽木谷朽木元纲处、藤堂高虎处、伊达政宗处……

paragraphs.source_zh: 随家康东去的诸将家眷自然严禁归领，在增田长盛的命令下，使者为人质之事飞驰向四面八方：大津京极高次处、朽木谷朽木元纲处、藤堂高虎处、伊达政宗处……

paragraphs.source_en: Although Kyōgoku Takatsugu was the younger brother of Lady Matsunomaru, one of Hideyoshi’s concubines, he had made a point of lavishly entertaining Ieyasu when the latter departed eastward, and so he refused the demand to surrender a hostage. Kutsuki Mototsuna, however, sent his eldest son Kumawaka to Osaka, while Date Masamune sent his eldest son Hidemune to Ukita Hideie. Takatora’s younger brother Takakiyo was demanded as a hostage, but Takatora’s retainers sternly refused.

units.source_en: Although Kyōgoku Takatsugu was the younger brother of Lady Matsunomaru, one of Hideyoshi’s concubines, he had made a point of lavishly entertaining Ieyasu when the latter departed eastward, and so he refused the demand to surrender a hostage.

ja.t: くもてなしていたため、

units.source_zh: 尽管京极高次乃秀吉侧室松丸夫人之弟，但家康东去之际，他特意盛情款待过，故拒绝了送交人质的要求。

units.source_en: Kutsuki Mototsuna, however, sent his eldest son Kumawaka to Osaka, while Date Masamune sent his eldest son Hidemune to Ukita Hideie.
units.source_zh: 但朽木元纲却把长子熊若送到大坂，伊达政宗也把长子秀宗送到宇喜多秀家处。

units.source_en: Takatora’s younger brother Takakiyo was demanded as a hostage, but Takatora’s retainers sternly refused.
units.source_zh: 本要求以高虎之弟高清为人质，却被高虎家臣严厉拒绝。

paragraphs.source_zh: 尽管京极高次乃秀吉侧室松丸夫人之弟，但家康东去之际，他特意盛情款待过，故拒绝了送交人质的要求。但朽木元纲却把长子熊若送到大坂，伊达政宗也把长子秀宗送到宇喜多秀家处。本要求以高虎之弟高清为人质，却被高虎家臣严厉拒绝。

paragraphs.source_en: At the same time, another messenger galloped toward Fushimi Castle, demanding that Mototada surrender it at once…

units.source_en: At the same time, another messenger galloped toward Fushimi Castle, demanding that Mototada surrender it at once…
units.source_zh: 在此同时，也有使者飞马驰向伏见城，要求元忠即刻献出城池……

paragraphs.source_zh: 在此同时，也有使者飞马驰向伏见城，要求元忠即刻献出城池……

paragraphs.source_en: Mashita Nagamori’s messenger first visited Fushimi Castle on the morning of the eighteenth. Torii Mototada had just finished meeting Sano Higo-no-kami Tsunamasa and had rebuked him severely: “With the realm in such turmoil, how could you abandon the Western Bailey and flee for your life?” Under Mototada’s stern questioning, Tsunamasa bowed his head and said nothing.

units.source_en: Mashita Nagamori’s messenger first visited Fushimi Castle on the morning of the eighteenth.
units.source_zh: 增田长盛的使者最初造访伏见城乃是十八日晨。

units.source_en: Torii Mototada had just finished meeting Sano Higo-no-kami Tsunamasa and had rebuked him severely: “With the realm in such turmoil, how could you abandon the Western Bailey and flee for your life?”

ja.t: としているというのに、どうして

units.source_zh: 此时鸟居元忠刚见毕佐野肥后守纲正，把他严厉斥责了一顿：“时局如此动荡不安，你怎能丢下西苑逃命？”

units.source_en: Under Mototada’s stern questioning, Tsunamasa bowed his head and said nothing.
units.source_zh: 在元忠的严厉诘责下，纲正低头不语。

paragraphs.source_zh: 增田长盛的使者最初造访伏见城乃是十八日晨。此时鸟居元忠刚见毕佐野肥后守纲正，把他严厉斥责了一顿：“时局如此动荡不安，你怎能丢下西苑逃命？”在元忠的严厉诘责下，纲正低头不语。

paragraphs.source_en: “Lord Torii, I have already brought the Naifu’s family safely to Yamato.”

units.source_en: “Lord Torii, I have already brought the Naifu’s family safely to Yamato.”
units.source_zh: “鸟居大人，在下已然平安把内府家小安置于大和了。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “鸟居大人，在下已然平安把内府家小安置于大和了。”

paragraphs.source_en: “I too know that what I did was wrong, and so I beg your forgiveness.”

units.source_en: “I too know that what I did was wrong, and so I beg your forgiveness.”

ja.t: っております。どうかご

units.source_zh: “在下也认为不妥，故想请大人宽谅。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “在下也认为不妥，故想请大人宽谅。”

paragraphs.source_en: “Do you think that after handing over the Western Bailey, a mere apology will settle the matter?”

units.source_en: “Do you think that after handing over the Western Bailey, a mere apology will settle the matter?”
units.source_zh: “你以为把西苑交了出去，致个歉就没事了？”

paragraphs.source_zh: “你以为把西苑交了出去，致个歉就没事了？”

paragraphs.source_en: “I understand. You are surely resolved to defend this castle to the death. I wish to remain here and lend what little strength I possess.”

units.source_en: “I understand.
units.source_zh: “在下明白。

units.source_en: You are surely resolved to defend this castle to the death. I wish to remain here and lend what little strength I possess.”
units.source_zh: 大人当然是决心死守城池，在下想在此尽绵薄之力。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “在下明白。大人当然是决心死守城池，在下想在此尽绵薄之力。”

paragraphs.source_en: Just then, Mashita Nagamori’s messenger, Itō Nagasue, arrived. Mototada broke off his conversation with Sano and went, leaning on his staff, to receive the messenger.

units.source_en: Just then, Mashita Nagamori’s messenger, Itō Nagasue, arrived.
units.source_zh: 正说到这里，增田长盛的使者伊藤长季来访。

units.source_en: Mototada broke off his conversation with Sano and went, leaning on his staff, to receive the messenger.
units.source_zh: 元忠中断了与佐野的谈话，拄杖去见使者。

paragraphs.source_zh: 正说到这里，增田长盛的使者伊藤长季来访。元忠中断了与佐野的谈话，拄杖去见使者。

paragraphs.source_en: Itō Nagasue spoke overbearingly: “The young lord has ordered that Fushimi Castle be requisitioned. Withdraw your troops immediately. This is His Lordship’s will.”

units.source_en: Itō Nagasue spoke overbearingly: “The young lord has ordered that Fushimi Castle be requisitioned.
units.source_zh: 伊藤长季盛气凌人：“少君有令，要征用伏见城。

units.source_en: Withdraw your troops immediately. This is His Lordship’s will.”
units.source_zh: 你的人马即刻撤出，此乃上意。”

paragraphs.source_zh: 伊藤长季盛气凌人：“少君有令，要征用伏见城。你的人马即刻撤出，此乃上意。”

paragraphs.source_en: For a moment, Itō Nagasue failed even to grasp the response. He stared at Mototada for a long while before saying, “Lord Torii, do you dare defy His Lordship’s command?”

units.source_en: For a moment, Itō Nagasue failed even to grasp the response. He stared at Mototada for a long while before saying, “Lord Torii, do you dare defy His Lordship’s command?”
units.source_zh: 伊藤长季一时竟没反应过来，他盯了元忠许久，方道：“鸟居大人，你敢不遵上谕？”

paragraphs.source_zh: 伊藤长季一时竟没反应过来，他盯了元忠许久，方道：“鸟居大人，你敢不遵上谕？”

paragraphs.source_en: “You must forgive my insolence.”

units.source_en: “You must forgive my insolence.”
units.source_zh: “恕我冒犯。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “恕我冒犯。”

paragraphs.source_en: “You will not obey even an order from the young lord?”

units.source_en: “You will not obey even an order from the young lord?”
units.source_zh: “即使是少君之令，你也不听？”

paragraphs.source_zh: “即使是少君之令，你也不听？”

paragraphs.source_en: “Is this truly the young lord’s command? I foresaw this long ago. Go back at once and tell your master that Torii Mototada will never surrender this castle.”

units.source_en: “Is this truly the young lord’s command?
